Rae (sales): Newton Health wants a 10-day POC for their "nh-med-30b-ftx" variant. They asked for onboarding steps, whether we can support per-tenant KMS, and a preliminary cost/latency estimate. Can we triage?
Hector (SE): quick clarifying Qs: artifact type (full checkpoint vs shards), tokenizer changes, any adapters/LoRA, expected peak RPS and typical seq length distribution?
Tomas (Newton Health): artifact = 30B safetensors sharded (5 files). No LoRA. Tokenizer = sentencepiece + 6 custom clinical tokens. Traffic: steady 40 rps, spikes 250 rps; seqs mostly 128-2k, occasional 8k. Need VPC + per-tenant BYOK; HIPAA required.
Mei (solutions): plan: 1) tokenization test for custom tokens 2) shard-load stress to detect OOM 3) KV/cache growth test for 2k and 8k contexts 4) staging perf run for p95 token latency under 40/250 rps 5) sketch pricing (hosted vs dedicated vs private).
Hector (SE): small note: per-tenant KMS adds a routing + keywrap step; infra can support it but we need KMS ARN list and IAM role. Also watch for tokenization mismatch increasing token counts.
Hector (SE): compat upload command (staging):
```
curl -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/compat/upload \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TEST" \
  -F "artifact=@nh_med_30b_sharded.tar.gz" \
  -F "meta=@meta.json" \
  -F "samples=@samples.zip"
```
Tomas (Newton Health): uploading now. also want to know if we support per-tenant latency SLAs (95p token) while still allowing fallback routes for non-PHI traffic.
Mei (solutions): we can propose private-only routing for PHI and soft-fallback to a smaller variant for non-PHI during capacity constraints. For SLAs, we'll need a commit level for Dedicated or Private. I'll draft scenarios.
Luka (security): intake: vendor questionnaire + HIPAA BA agreement + KMS ARNs + data flow diagram. PHI requests must be private-only and have no external analytics. Tomas, can you provide the KMS ARNs and confirm retention limits?
Tomas (Newton Health): will share ARNs and retention policy by EOD. Also ask: any tokenization issues will we be charged extra for token count variance?
Rae (sales): we'll call that out in the commercial note: quoted token usage assumes tokenizer parity; significant delta may require re-estimate.
BuildBot: scheduled compat-job #cj-7722 for 2025-09-30T05:00:00Z (staging). est runtime ~40m.
Hector (SE): perf hint: 30B int8 on similar infra -> p95 token latency rough ballpark 80-140ms for <=512 tokens with batching; 2k and 8k will be higher proportionally. We'll post measured numbers after compat job.
Mei (solutions): owners: samples + artifact (Tomas), compat & perf runs (Hector), pricing scenarios + commit options (Mei), security intake + BA (Luka), sales deck update (Rae). ETA: samples today -> tests tomorrow -> initial numbers in 48h.
Tomas (Newton Health): uploading artifacts & tokenization examples (will include raw->tokens). Thanks all. :rocket:
